header: I use this when a circular is opened at a given page (the "Source" bar of a health check-up answer, a search match). On a FIRST visit the page images all load at the same time and each one has no height until it arrives, so every page ABOVE the target pushes the target further down as it loads. Scrolling when only the target's own image has loaded therefore lands on the wrong place; on a second visit the images are cached, nothing shifts, and it works. So my scroll waits until every image at and above the target has loaded (or failed), which is the moment the target's position is final. The images below the target cannot move it, so I do not wait for them. I keep it pure (the images and the timers are passed in) so that it can be tested without a browser.

symbols.name: whenImagesSettled
symbols.sig: export function whenImagesSettled(imgs: ImgLike[], go: () => void, opts: { timeoutMs?: number; timers?: Timers } = {}): () => void
doc: I call `go` (once, always asynchronously) when every image has finished loading or failed, or after `timeoutMs` if one never does. Returns a function that cancels: `go` is then never called and every listener is removed.

symbols.name: isAligned
symbols.sig: export function isAligned(targetTop: number, viewTop: number, scrollMargin: number, tolerance = 24): boolean
doc: After the scroll, I check whether the target is where it was meant to be (its top at the scroll margin of the viewport's top, give or take `tolerance` pixels).

behaviours: all images already loaded: nothing is called at once (always asynchronous)...
...and once the page has been laid out: called exactly once, with no listeners ever attached
the target's own image (the last one) has loaded but two pages above have not: NOT yet (this was the bug)
the moment the last page above arrives: called, once
...and every listener is removed
the timeout that was waiting does not call it again
a page that fails to load does not hold the scroll back for ever
images already loaded are not listened to
it waits only for the one that was still loading
a page that never arrives: still waiting just before the 10 s limit
...at 10 s it goes ahead anyway (once) and lets go of the listeners
a late arrival after that does not call it a second time
the limit can be set (500 ms)
cancelled: every listener is removed at once
...and it is never called, however the images arrive afterwards
cancelled while nothing was pending: not called either
cancelling after it has finished is harmless
no images at all: called once, asynchronously
aligned: the top is at the scroll margin (16 px) below the viewer's top
aligned within 24 px either way, not beyond
far away (the old bug: 5,000 px below, or well above): not aligned
a tighter tolerance can be given (2 px, used while pinning)
